CRM setup: amoCRM, Bitrix24 or custom

Every call and enquiry lands in the CRM and none get lost; the owner sees the sales funnel and each manager's work in real time. An MVP in 3–6 weeks, from UZS 36 mln; the full version in 10–20 weeks.

Questions

What does “CRM setup: amoCRM, Bitrix24 or custom” cost?
The MVP costs $3,000–8,000 (UZS 36–97 mln), the full version $15,000–45,000 (UZS 180–545 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “CRM setup: amoCRM, Bitrix24 or custom” take?
The MVP takes 3–6 weeks, the full version 10–20 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today: who does what; existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
